release_notes: HP ANALYSIS & TRANSFORMS: Freeze Transformations now handles complete parent hierarchies and newly created HP/LP subgroups keep identity local transforms. HP classification evaluates complete assemblies instead of depending on the first mesh, keeps identical fasteners together, preserves confident LP ownership, and produces deterministic groups. Faster native shape analysis and safer runtime loading are included for Maya 2022-2027. HP-LP Matcher is temporarily hidden.
